data.one_liner: WhatsApp-like text styling widget and controller for Flutter with support for bold, italic, and links.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom Text widget and a TextEditingController that automatically format text based on WhatsApp-style syntax markers like asterisks for bold, underscores for italics, and hashes for underlines. It supports backend-driven styling, custom link recognizers, and text selection context menus.
use_when: You want to implement chat messaging text formatting similar to WhatsApp or Telegram.
You need backend-driven text styling without complex custom parsing code.
You require a TextField controller that previews formatted text in real-time.
avoid_when: You need a full rich-text WYSIWYG editor with multiple fonts and complex paragraph formatting.
You are using a text rendering format entirely incompatible with marker-based syntax.
strengths: Familiar WhatsApp-like syntax that users already understand.
Includes both a custom display widget and a TypeSetEditingController for input fields.
weaknesses: Requires escaping characters if you need literal usage of formatting markers like asterisks.
Limited to predefined formatting syntax styles (bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, monospace, links, font size).
